description: Docs and the TTY refusal imply --stdout is safe, but an agent's shell is not a terminal, so an unpiped `credentials export --stdout` prints the bundle into the agent transcript.
expected: Doc warns agents to always pipe; guard or warning on unpiped use by agents
actual: Non-TTY run printed the bundle (417 bytes) with no warning
evidence: CLI: export --stdout | wc -c => 417; docs/sandboxes.md 'prints the bundle only when stdout is not a terminal'
suggested_fix: State plainly in docs: always pipe to a store; never run it bare in an agent shell. Optionally add a required --yes-print flag.

description: Missing/invalid-bundle errors do not tell the user how to recover or name the env variable when it is empty.
actual: 'AGENT_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS is not a valid credentials bundle.' and, when empty, 'API configuration is missing. Run `agent-drive login` ...'
suggested_fix: Add: 'Copy the full line from your secret store (it starts adcred1.) or run agent-drive credentials export on the original machine.'

description: Clipboard failure says 'outside the repo' where sandbox docs and BACKUP_HINT say 'outside the sandbox'; neither mentions --stdout|confirm.
actual: Use `--to 1password` or `--to <a file outside the repo>` instead.
suggested_fix: Unify wording and add the stdout route.
